scope: All 100 words in the second onomatopoeia cohort, including the three enriched existing cards.
scene_basis: Original English scenarios based on the reviewed card senses and examples; not copied photographs or manga.
advisory_method: Direct contact-sheet inspection, enlarging unclear examples, against the selected sense, visible text, scene accuracy, anatomy and plausible confusions.
owner_review: accepted for learning use on 2026-10-19; actual study feedback pending
limits: An illustration depicts one selected use, not every sense of its word.
Sounds, repeated motion, tastes, private feelings and preceding events cannot be fully established from a still image.
Existing direct quiz exclusions remain in force; this is not exhaustive proof that all possible randomized choices are visually unique.
The advisory visual pass is not an independent two-model image review or native-speaker certification. Owner acceptance is recorded separately.
This image review does not certify physical-phone rendering or learning outcomes.
